facts: The hotel describes panoramic Gotjawal forest and Seogwang Dawon green-tea-field views.
It states it has 110 rooms, restaurant, banquet halls, meeting rooms, business center, convenience store and gym.
All guestrooms have private balconies and the hotel describes the stay as relaxing.
The official site identifies the location as Andeok-myeon, Seogwipo, Jeju.
Its restaurant uses seasonal ingredients sourced across Jeju Island; it also has a dining and cafe space.
A family room is described as having green-tea-field and Sanbangsan views, and another room has an outer-space-inspired interior.
The official tourist-shuttle map lists Jeju Aerospace Hotel on the route between Jeju Aerospace Museum, O'Sulloc Tea Museum and other Jung-sangan attractions.
The guidebook describes the hotel as a comfortable, cozy travel stay.

theme.mountain.rationale: Some rooms officially foreground Sanbangsan views, but the hotel itself is not a mountain visit or hiking attraction.

theme.ocean.rationale: Official descriptions foreground Gotjawal, tea fields and Sanbangsan rather than an ocean/coastal experience.

theme.activity.rationale: The documented offer is accommodation, dining and event facilities; no activity program is presented as the visit purpose.

theme.culture_history.rationale: No cultural-heritage or historical interpretation is described for the hotel itself.

theme.theme_park.rationale: This is a hotel, not a theme park; nearby aerospace attractions do not change the place's own type.

theme.cafe.rationale: The operator lists an on-site dining and cafe space, but accommodation is the primary purpose.

theme.festival.rationale: Banquet and meeting spaces do not establish a public festival as the visit purpose.

environment.indoor_ratio.rationale: The stay centers on guestrooms and indoor restaurant, meeting, business, convenience-store and gym facilities.

environment.weather_sensitivity.rationale: Core lodging, dining and facility use is indoors; balcony and landscape enjoyment are supplementary.

style_evidence.restfulness.rationale: The operator explicitly frames private balconies, natural sounds and green views as a relaxing stay experience.

style_evidence.physical_ease.hold_reason: Official materials list a five-floor hotel and indoor facilities but provide no place-specific step-free, elevator or accessible-room evidence.
style_evidence.physical_ease.rationale: Do not infer high physical ease solely from the accommodation category.

style_evidence.visit_duration_flexibilit.rationale: It supports varied stays (leisure, business, meetings and family vacations) with rooms, dining and several facilities rather than a fixed short attraction circuit.

style_evidence.scenic_value.rationale: The hotel officially markets panoramic Gotjawal forest, Seogwang Dawon tea-field and Sanbangsan views.

style_evidence.distinctiveness.rationale: The operator describes an aerospace/outer-space interior concept, but the documented offering remains a conventional four-star hotel.

style_evidence.local_embeddedness.rationale: It is a Jeju-based property whose official positioning uses Gotjawal, Seogwang tea fields and Jeju-sourced seasonal ingredients. Evidence does not establish it as a heritage institution or uniquely local community business.

style_evidence.landmark_significance.rationale: Visit Jeju includes the hotel as a stop on a tourist shuttle among major nearby attractions, but no source calls the hotel itself a landmark.

style_evidence.photo_value.rationale: The operator explicitly sells panoramic forest, tea-field and mountain views, supporting moderate visual value; no official source establishes it as a photo destination.

derived_style.healing_slow.hold_reason: physical_ease remains needs_review due to absent accessibility evidence.

derived_style.discovery_explorer.hold_reason: No place-specific source-backed input is defined for this derived label.
